title: Four toolbar directions for Excalidraw
summary: Compare four responses to the toolbar usability tests: fewer decisions, friendlier labels, faster access, or bigger touch targets. The original toolbar is still the default.

variations.name: Minimal and calm
variations.idea: Keep six sketching essentials in sight and tuck everything else behind More tools.

variations.name: Playful and expressive
variations.idea: A sticker-sheet sketch kit with color-coded tools that lift off the page when picked.

variations.name: Dense for power users
variations.idea: Every tool in sight, with keyboard shortcuts on the buttons and a strip for frequent canvas actions.

variations.name: Big and touch friendly
variations.idea: A thumb-height dock with big, labeled targets and an extra tray that opens upward.
